theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_slice
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (RT : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (RB : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), m + 1 < P → RT.Represents T → RB.Represents T.boundary → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ Ps : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → AEMeasurable (fun t => (Ps t).massOn W) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (Ps t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * T.massOn W) ∧ ∀ᵐ t, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ps t) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) (f ⁻¹' {t}) → Ps t ω = 0) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Ps t ω = (∫ x in RT.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 2]) - ∫ x in RB.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 1]
